Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

* Market Relationships: Proven track record of managing senior relationships within the Canadian media agency landscape and securing major commercial deals.

Title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Transformation Advisor), Independent Software Vendor (ISV)
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Canada is looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) team, a role at the intersection of technology strategy, business transformation, and customer partnership.  
  
You will own the success of a portfolio of Canadian ISVs navigating multi-year cloud, SaaS, and AI transformation journeys. Your job is to ensure these companies don't just adopt AWS; they build competitive advantage on it. That means helping them migrate critical workloads, accelerate AI and agentic capability adoption, and translate their technology investments into measurable business outcomes.  
  
In this role you are connecting ISV customers to the right AWS expertise, programs, and teams at the right time, and holding the thread across complex, multi-stakeholder environments.  
  
If you thrive where technical depth and business strategy intersect, and you want your work to have visible, lasting impact on how Canada's most innovative software companies grow, then this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Drive Customer Outcomes  

* Own the success of a portfolio of ISV accounts, working backwards from each customer's strategic milestones to define and execute a clear path to value realization
* Lead roadmap-to-outcome alignment sessions,
* Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live milestones that accelerate each customer's cloud and AI journey
* Help ISVs build the governance, operating models, and data infrastructure needed to sustain long-term transformation, not just hit short-term milestones
* Support customers in adopting generative AI and agentic capabilities that are reshaping how software is built, delivered, and monetized

  
Orchestrate Across AWS  

* Serve as the connective tissue between ISV customers and AWS teams (Sales, Solutions Architecture, Support, Professional Services, and Partner teams) ensuring coordinated, high-quality engagement
* Contribute to account planning, translating strategic goals into executable actions with clear ownership and timelines
* Identify and remove systemic barriers that slow customer progress, escalating with precision and urgency when needed

  
Lead Strategic Engagements  

* Lead director-level engagements, co-innovation workshops, and strategic planning sessions with Product, Engineering, and Technology leadership within ISV accounts
* Help translate complex AI and cloud solutions into business cases for senior stakeholders, bridging the gap between technical teams and executive decision-makers
* Support customers through critical decision points: workload migration sequencing, AI adoption strategy, SaaS architecture evolution

  
Manage with Rigor  

* Maintain structured cadence through reporting, tracking, and health monitoring across your portfolio
* Apply structured delivery mechanisms and measurement frameworks to ensure customers realize the value of their AWS investment
* Proactively identify risks (technical, organizational, or commercial) and drive mitigation plans before they become escalations

  
Raise the Bar Internally  

* Challenge conventional thinking and take initiative on customer challenges, bringing new ideas, tools, and mechanisms to problems
* Bring the best of AWS and Amazon to customers, proactively solving problems by connecting them to emerging capabilities, programs, and expertise they may not know exist
* Contribute to repeatable mechanisms and internal enablement, sharing learnings from your customer engagements to help raise the bar for how AWS delivers customer success in Canada.

  
About the team  
You don't need to build cloud infrastructure, but you need to understand it well enough to earn the trust of the engineers who do.  
  
On any given day, you might help a VP/Director of Product at a Canadian SaaS company understand the business case for migrating their core platform to AWS, facilitate an alignment session between an ISV's engineering team and AWS Solutions Architecture, or work with your internal team to unblock a stalled migration that's at risk of missing its go-live milestone.  
  
You'll be working with some of Canada's most innovative software companies at a pivotal moment, when AI is fundamentally changing how software is built, delivered, and monetized. If you thrive in environments where technical depth and clear communication are equally valued, this role is for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion
* Experience in customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
* 5+ years of IT and/or Management Consulting experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Cloud Technology Certification, or AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

* Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce platform by:

* Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer

* Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
* Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high-severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
* Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.
* Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Experienced professional with 8+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
* Exceptional English & Arabic communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
* Skills for analyzing technical concepts, translating them into business terms, and mapping business requirements into technical features.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
* Knowledge of software development process and design methodologies.
* Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate the resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.
* **Fluency in both Arabic and English is essential**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* +2 years in the Salesforce Ecosystem.
* Salesforce product certifications are a plus ( **Administrator** , Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, **Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant** ).
* Knowledge of Salesforce products and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy.

* Strategic partners and third-party suppliers
* Market Area and global Ericsson stakeholders

* Lead the CSS business agenda across the full lifecycle, from early customer engagement and opportunity shaping through pre-sales, contracting, delivery, adoption, value realization, renewal, upsell, and cross-sell.

* Identify customer business needs and translate them into practical, scalable, and de-risked solution approaches that deliver measurable business outcomes.

* Lead the development of customer engagement plans, growth plans, account strategies, and opportunity execution plans in collaboration with KAMs and cross-functional teams.

* Drive continuous improvement through automation, digitalization, standardized ways of working, performance transparency, knowledge reuse, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with partners and internal organizations to strengthen the end-to-end CSS offering and expand the value delivered to customers.

* Proven experience managing complex customer engagements across sales, pre-sales, delivery, and the customer lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of CSS offerings, service management, operational transformation, automation, digitalization, and customer experience.
* Demonstrated ability to lead business growth, manage senior customer relationships, and deliver commercial results in a complex matrix organization.
* Experience managing or influencing large, geographically distributed, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including understanding of revenue, margin, cost, forecasting, pricing, investment, and risk management.

Title: Delivery Program Director

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.

Title: Associate Director, Operations & Maintenance (O&M)
Description:
**Job Purpose**

Dedicated to Pactive, the Associate Director, O&M is accountable for the safe, reliable and profitable operation of Pactive's installed asset base, including solar PV, battery energy storage, LED lighting, BMS and metering, HVAC and chiller plant, EV charging and energy performance (ESCO) contracts across Aldar Group and third-party clients. The role turns O&M from a cost-to-serve activity into a recurring-revenue and margin business. It leads the O&M team and subcontractors, guarantees contractual availability, performance ratio and energy savings, protects warranties and performance guarantees, builds the remote monitoring and command-and-control capability, and grows the O&M order book through renewals, upsell and new long-term service contracts.

**Job Details**

**Roles, Responsibilities, Duties**

Associate Director, Operations & Maintenance (O&M)

* **O&M Portfolio Leadership:**
  Own the end-to-end delivery of all Pactive O&M contracts, including preventive, corrective and predictive maintenance, for solar PV (rooftop, carport and ground mount), BESS, lighting, BMS, metering, HVAC, EV chargers and energy performance contracts. Set annual maintenance plans, resource plans and budgets for each contract and ensure delivery against scope, SLA, cost and quality.
* **Asset Performance & Availability:**
  Guarantee contractual availability, performance ratio (PR), yield and response and resolution times. Lead root-cause analysis of under-performance, equipment failures and generation losses, and drive corrective actions. Track and report performance against guaranteed values and minimise liquidated damages and performance penalties.
* **Energy Savings & M&V Guarantees:**
  Working with the M&V team, ensure that energy performance and shared-savings contracts deliver verified savings in line with IPMVP and contractual guarantees. Coordinate operational changes, set-points and maintenance practices that protect and grow savings, including multi-owner and owners association portfolios.
* **Remote Monitoring & Command Centre:**
  Build and run Pactive's remote monitoring and command-and-control capability (SCADA, inverter and BMS platforms, CMMS). Define alarm management, escalation and dispatch protocols, use data analytics for predictive maintenance, and deliver live performance dashboards to clients and management.
* **Commercial Growth & Recurring Revenue:**
  Grow the O&M order book through contract renewals, scope extensions, retrofits, repowering and upsell of additional services. Support Growth & Key Accounts on O&M pricing, proposals and bids, and convert Pactive's EPC handovers into long-term O&M agreements. Develop O&M offerings for third-party and developer-owned assets, including Aldar Group and joint venture portfolios.
* **Contract, Cost & Margin Management:**
  Own the P&L of the O&M portfolio. Manage contract scope, variations, claims, invoicing milestones and collections with Commercial & Controls. Monitor cost to serve, labour productivity, spare parts consumption and subcontractor spend, and protect gross margin on every contract. Holds approval authority only within the Pactive Delegation of Authority.
* **Warranty, Spares & Subcontractor Management:**
  Manage OEM warranties and performance guarantees for modules, inverters, batteries and other critical equipment, including claims and replacements. Maintain strategic spares holdings and stock levels. Select, manage and performance-review O&M subcontractors and specialist service providers in coordination with Procurement.
* **Handover & Lifecycle Engineering:**
  Define O&M requirements at design and tender stage, and lead the acceptance of new assets from Project Delivery (punch lists, as-built documentation, testing and commissioning records, training and spares). Plan mid-life refurbishment, component replacement and end-of-life strategies for the asset base.
* **Team Leadership & Capability:**
  Lead, develop and organise the O&M managers, engineers, supervisors and technicians across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and other regions. Set clear roles, KPIs and competency frameworks, plan succession, and build technical skills in solar, storage, electrical HV/LV and building systems. Foster a culture of safety, ownership and client service.
* **Client & Stakeholder Management:**
  Act as senior O&M point of contact for key clients, asset owners, Aldar Group entities, Khidmah/FM partners and authorities (DEWA, ADDC/TAQA and other utilities). Lead periodic performance reviews, manage escalations and maintain high client satisfaction and renewal rates. Agree the boundary of services with Khidmah and other group FM providers.
* **Executive & Monthly Reporting:**
  Prepare concise executive-level reports, monthly management packs and dashboards covering asset availability and PR, energy yield and savings, SLA compliance, incidents, backlog, cost, margin, order book and renewals, key risks and agreed O&M metrics. Convert complex operational data into clear actions and recommendations.
* **Standards, Compliance & Continuous Improvement:**
  Develop and maintain O&M policies, procedures and method statements aligned with OEM requirements, IEC and applicable UAE codes and authority regulations. Maintain audit-ready maintenance records in the CMMS. Drive standardisation, digitalisation, process discipline and ISO 9001/14001/45001/55001 alignment across the portfolio.
* **Key Performance Indicators:**
  Contractual availability and PR achieved; verified energy savings against guarantee; SLA response and resolution compliance; preventive maintenance completion; zero lost-time incidents; O&M revenue growth and renewal rate; gross margin per contract; warranty claims recovered; client satisfaction scores.
* **Occupational Health, Safety & Environment:**
  Adhere to all Pactive and Khidmah HSE policies, procedures, practices and applicable legal and statutory requirements, and remain current with updates. Ensure safe systems of work for all O&M activities, including permit to work, LOTO, working at height and electrical safety, and lead incident investigation and corrective actions.
* **Information Security responsibilities:**
* Comply with Pactive and Khidmah Information Security policies,
* Be aware of and fulfill their information security responsibilities
* Ensure whoever handles sensitive company information have taken the Security Awareness Training
* Know how to report a security incident (to IT ServiceDesk or InfoSec).
* Not Disable his/her OS firewall and/or Antivirus
* Restrict use to authorized purposes, Protect access accounts, privileges and associated passwords.
* Accept accountability of his/her individual user accounts and maintain confidentiality.

**Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Energy or Renewable Energy Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Professional engineering registration or certification (e.g. CEng, PE) and CEM, CMVP or asset management (IAM/ISO 55001) qualification is strongly preferred.
* DEWA and/or ADDC solar PV or electrical certification, NEBOSH or IOSH safety qualification, and a postgraduate business or management qualification are an advantage.

**Experience and Skills:**

**Experience:**

* Approximately 12-18 years of progressive experience in O&M, asset management or technical services, including at least 5 years leading multi-site O&M portfolios and teams.
* Proven experience operating utility-scale and/or distributed solar PV assets; experience with BESS, energy efficiency, ESCO or building systems (BMS, HVAC, lighting) is highly desirable.
* Track record of delivering contractual availability, performance ratio and energy savings guarantees, and of managing O&M contracts with SLAs and liquidated damages.
* Experience in the UAE or GCC, with working knowledge of DEWA, ADDC/TAQA and other authority requirements, net metering and grid connection rules.
* Demonstrated P&L ownership of a service or O&M business, including growth of recurring revenue through renewals and new contracts.

**Technical & Commercial Capability:**

* Strong understanding of PV, inverter, BESS and electrical HV/LV systems, monitoring platforms (SCADA, CMMS) and data-driven predictive maintenance.
* Able to interpret contract terms, cost to serve, budgets, forecasts, actuals and variances, and to price O&M scopes competitively and profitably.
* Advanced analytical capability, with confidence developing performance analytics, management information and executive reporting.

**Skills & Behaviours:**

* Inspiring, hands-on leader able to build and motivate field teams and hold subcontractors to account.
* Uncompromising commitment to safety and service quality.
* Credible with clients and senior management; strong negotiation skills.
* Excellent communication; able to distil complex technical information into concise recommendations.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint capability; experience with CMMS, SCADA/monitoring and ERP (SAP) tools is expected.
* Fluent professional English; Arabic is an advantage. Valid UAE driving licence required.

Title: Senior Delivery Manager
Description:
Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.  
We've earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

**Position Overview**

As a Senior Delivery Manager, you are the senior delivery authority on a cross-functional engagement: owning execution from kickoff through release, leading distributed onshore-and-offshore teams, and serving as the primary delivery partner to the client. You bring the judgment to navigate ambiguity, the discipline to keep complex programs on track, and the instinct to make every engagement a foundation for the next one.

  

**Why This Role Matters**

Senior Delivery Managers are where Robots and Pencils' promise of "production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days" actually has to hold. On the engagements you run, you set the pace of delivery, the discipline behind it, and the trust that decides whether the client comes back for more. The work moves only as fast as someone is willing to own the plan, surface trade-offs early, and keep distributed teams pulling in the same direction.

**What** **You'll** **Do**

**Craft & Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-phase engagements, ensuring alignment across scope, budget, timeline, and quality to meet delivery commitments and achieve successful outcomes

* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution across one or more cross-functional teams

* Manage phased releases, production readiness, and transitions into operations and maintenance models

* Identify and proactively manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and escalations before they become blockers

* Define, track, and report delivery KPIs, using data to guide decisions, manage delivery health, and inform tradeoffs across scope, timeline, and budget

* Support QA and UAT efforts, ensuring quality is validated and outcomes meet agreed acceptance criteria

* Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and stakeholder communications

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Serve as the primary delivery contact for clients, building trusted relationships through transparency, consistency, and clear communication while identifying opportunities to expand value within the engagement

* Lead stakeholder working sessions, roadmap alignment discussions, and delivery forums with confidence

* Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to executive and non-technical audiences

* Partner with Client Partners to spot expansion opportunities inside the engagement (scope, follow-on work, new use cases) and help shape the case for what's next

* Translate delivery progress into business impact for client stakeholders (ROI, milestones, decisions) so executives see ongoing value, not just status

**Leadership & Influence**

* Lead distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence

* Coach junior delivery managers with concrete feedback and stretch opportunities, contributing to their development plans

* Foster a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and high performance across the engagement

* Contribute to improving delivery practices, tools, and frameworks across engagements

* Assess team strengths and gaps on your engagements, and partner with Client Partners to flag staffing needs and high-potential talent for the firm

* Conduct executive interviews for engineers, designers, and other roles joining your engagements, and serve as an essential voice in go/no-go hiring decisions across the firm

  

**What** **You'll** **Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in software delivery, technical project management, or engineering leadership

* Strong understanding of agile delivery practices across complex, multi-team engagements (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, Kanban)

* Experience managing distributed teams across onshore and offshore locations

* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-platform digital systems in agile environments

* Strong client-facing communication and relationship management skills

* Experience with delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines)

* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and AI-enabled platforms

* Demonstrable usage of AI tools to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and documentation (e.g., Claude)

* PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, or equivalent certification preferred

* Experience in regulated environments (e.g., utilities, government, finance) is a plus

* Instinct for spotting where an engagement can grow, and the credibility with clients to bring those conversations forward with Client Partners

  

**Helpful Extras and Unique Skills**

* Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing

* Experience delivering agentic, AI co-worker, or applied-AI initiatives in enterprise

* Prior career experience in client-facing roles (engagement management, consulting, account leadership) that informs growth conversations

**You'll** **Do Well Here if You Are**

* **A doer.** You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.

* **A fast learner who knows you don't know everything.** The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.

* **Direct in a way that makes the work better.** You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.

* **Obsessed with craft.** You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.

* **Built for ownership.** You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.

* **All in.** You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.

* **Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight.** Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.

* **Calm when it gets hot.** When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You'd rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.

* **Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do.** Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

Title: Head of IT Security
Description:
Job Description:

* Overall security posture of the Group's technology estate, measured against an agreed target maturity (e.g. NIST CSF / ISO 27001 controls)
* Detection and response: 24/7 monitoring coverage, mean time to detect and respond, and effective containment of security incidents
* Vulnerability and patch management: timely remediation of critical and high vulnerabilities across infrastructure and applications
* Identity and access security: privileged access management, MFA coverage and periodic access reviews
* Security by design: security requirements, architecture reviews and testing embedded in digital, cloud and AI projects before go-live
* Regulatory and certification compliance: clean audit outcomes against QCB, NCSA and ISO 27001 / PCI DSS requirements, and timely closure of findings
* Data protection controls (DLP, encryption, email and web security) protecting customer and corporate data
* Security awareness, phishing resilience and a well-structured, capable IT Security team
* Lead the IT Security function under the Group Chief Digital & AI Officer, alongside Head of Group IT and Head of Data & AI
* Owns first-line security controls and operations; works with the Cyber Security & Data Protection Officer (Group Risk) who owns security policy, risk appetite and second-line oversight
* Engages directly with Group IT, Data & AI, digital product teams, business units, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Legal and external vendors
* Operates information security policies, risk and compliance frameworks, and the requirements of QCB, NCSA (National Information Assurance standard), Qatar's personal data protection law and other applicable regulators
* Functions in a fast-changing environment of cloud adoption, digital ecosystem launches and AI deployment, with a 24/7 threat landscape
* Significant autonomy over security architecture, tooling and operations; escalates major incidents, material risks and risk acceptances to the Group Chief Digital & AI Officer and Group Risk
* Prioritizes security investments and remediation across a broad estate with finite budget, people and change windows
* Leads the response to live security incidents under time pressure — containment, forensics, recovery and lessons learned
* Balances strong controls with business agility, enabling digital and AI initiatives without creating unmanaged risk
* Assesses the security of new technologies (cloud services, APIs, third-party platforms, generative AI) and designs proportionate controls
* Interprets regulatory and audit requirements across multiple jurisdictions and translates them into practical technical controls
* Manages third-party and supply-chain security risk across technology vendors and outsourced services
* Translates technical threat and vulnerability data into clear, risk-based messages for executives and committee
* Defines IT security architecture, technical standards and baseline configurations for the Group's technology estate
* Selects security tools and managed-security providers and manages the security budget within delegated authority
* Approves or blocks go-live of systems and changes based on security review outcomes, within the agreed governance framework
* Directs incident response, including containment actions such as isolating systems or disabling compromised accounts
* Sets remediation priorities and deadlines for vulnerabilities and audit findings with Group IT and application owners
* Hires, develops and manages the performance of the IT Security team, in line with HR policies

Educational Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field
* Master's degree in Information Security or a related field is preferred
* Professional security certification (CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP or equivalent) strongly preferred; vendor certifications (e.g. Fortinet, Microsoft, cloud security) are an advantage

Experience:

* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT, with at least 5 years in information / cyber security
* Minimum 3 years leading an IT security or cybersecurity team, including SOC or security operations
* Proven track record in financial services (insurance, banking, payments or fintech) or another regulated industry
* Hands-on experience with enterprise security technologies: firewalls / NGFW, SIEM, EDR, WAF, DLP,IAM / PAM
* Experience leading ISO 27001 and / or PCI DSS compliance and regulatory or external audits
* Experience managing managed-security providers and international technology vendors • GCC / Qatar regulatory exposure (QCB, NCSA) is a strong plus; insurance industry experience is an advantage

Title: Senior Manager - IT/OT Network Security - AA9
Description:
Act as the single point of contact between District ICT Operations and Corporate IT for all IT/OT network and security matters. The role manages the relationship, coordinates incidents, escalations, changes and requests, and keeps both parties aligned.
  
  
**Key competencies**

* Managing cross-organizational relationships and building trust with Corporate IT leadership
* Calm, structured coordination during incidents and escalations
* Clear communication of technical issues, impacts and decisions to mixed audiences
* Influence and negotiation without direct authority
* Disciplined tracking, follow-through and governance reporting

**Key Responsibilities**

* Single point of contact: Serve as the primary interface with Corporate IT for all IT/OT network and security issues, requests and dependencies
* Incident and escalation coordination: Coordinate incidents involving Corporate IT, including major incidents. Drive timely engagement, clear ownership and resolution, and manage escalations through agreed paths
* Change and dependency coordination: Make sure District ICT changes, projects and design reviews that affect Corporate IT networks or security are raised, coordinated and approved through the right Corporate IT channels
* Security and access requests: Coordinate firewall rules, connectivity, access and security requests with Corporate IT, and track them through to completion
* Engagement model: Define and maintain the operating interface with Corporate IT: contacts, escalation matrix, OLAs, meeting cadence and responsibilities
* Governance and reporting: Run regular service reviews with Corporate IT. Report on open issues, risks, dependencies and performance to the Associate Director

**Requirements**
**Interactions/ Engagement**

* Corporate IT network, security and operations teams: Primary counterpart for all IT/OT matters
* Associate Director and District ICT leadership: Escalations, risks and governance reporting
* Major incident, change and L1.5 teams: Incident coordination and change alignment
* Design assurance, project and operational readiness teams: Corporate IT dependencies and approvals
* Vendors and MSPs: Issues that cross Corporate IT boundaries

**Key Technical Skills**

* 10+ years in IT or OT operations, including 4+ years in service or relationship management
* Sound understanding of IT/OT network segmentation, connectivity and cybersecurity principles
* Strong grasp of ITIL 4 incident, change and escalation management practices
* Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices and governance in multi-party environments
* ITIL 4, CCNP or equivalent required; a cybersecurity awareness certification (e.g. CompTIA Security+) desirable

Working closely with the Global Security Director, Assistance, Regional Operations Directors and wider global security network, you will drive operational excellence, strengthen regional capabilities and ensure consistent service delivery in line with International SOS standards and client expectations.

You will also play an important role in developing regional security talent, supporting business growth, strengthening client relationships and maintaining operational readiness in an evolving security environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Management and Leadership**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Security Managers, Security Specialists and associated security personnel across the region.
* Lead, coach and develop regional security teams, promoting professional growth, engagement and high performance.
* Oversee performance management, objective setting, succession planning and workforce development.
* Ensure effective resource planning and allocation to meet operational demands and client requirements.
* Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, operational excellence and customer focus.

* Act as a senior escalation point for complex security cases, incidents and operational challenges.
* Coordinate security responses to emergencies, critical incidents and crisis situations.
* Monitor regional security developments and ensure operational responses reflect current threat assessments and intelligence.
* Provide senior-level review and quality assurance of security advice, assessments and recommendations.
* Maintain regional operational preparedness plans, procedures and response protocols.
* Oversee regional security provider networks, partnerships and the Secure Hotel Programme.
* Support Incident Management Teams and Crisis Management Teams during major incidents and events.
* Promote effective collaboration across Medical, Operations, Travel, Aviation, Network Services and Intelligence & Analysis teams.

**Consulting Delivery & Sales, Marketing Support**

* Deliver high-quality security consulting services in line with client requirements.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of security risk assessments, country assessments, travel security programmes and tailored client solutions.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, workshops and business development engagements.
* Deliver security briefings, webinars, training programmes and awareness sessions.
* Support the preparation of proposals, tenders and commercial opportunities.
* Contribute to client retention through expert advice and excellent service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to enhance existing services and develop new client value propositions.
* Represent International SOS at relevant industry events, conferences and stakeholder meetings.
* Support regional commercial objectives through security expertise and operational insight

**Required Experience & Skills**
--------------------------------

* At least 8 years of experience in security operations and planning, including operational deployment in hostile and/or challenging environments.
* Experience gained within private security companies, military, NGOs, government or relevant private-sector organisations, ideally within the Middle East.
* Proven experience in leading and managing security teams, including remote or hybrid teams.
* Strong experience in planning and managing security assistance operations.
* Extensive knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse risk environments.
* Strong understanding of the political, security and threat landscape across the Middle East and wider region.
* Experience in conducting security risk assessments and developing practical risk mitigation strategies.
* Ability to analyse complex security, logistical and threat-related information and translate findings into clear recommendations and action plans.
* Experience preparing reports and providing advice to senior management and decision-makers.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and cross-cultural collaboration skills.
* Strong IT proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.

**Desirable Experience**

* Crisis management and emergency response experience.
* Security consulting and training delivery.
* Client-facing presentations, public speaking and media engagement.
* Business development and commercial support.
* Quality management and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications & Education**
------------------------------

* Degree-level education in Security Studies, Conflict Studies, International Politics, International Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent professional training and experience.
* Accreditation or membership with a recognised regional security or risk management professional body is desirable.

**Languages**
-------------

* Excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Arabic, French or another European language would be an advantage.

**Why Join International SOS?**
-------------------------------

Join a global organisation where your expertise can make a meaningful difference in protecting people and supporting organisations operating in complex environments.

At International SOS, you will work alongside experienced professionals across a global network, contribute to critical security operations and help deliver services that protect the health, safety and security of people worldwide.

**If you are an experienced security leader looking for an opportunity to make an impact on a regional and global scale, we would like to hear from you.**

* 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including experience leading technical teams or major platform initiatives.

* Experience supporting large-scale, consumer-facing digital products or high-availability digital platforms.
* Proven ability to lead and mentor engineers while driving complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.

* Effective communication skills and the ability to partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Title: Middle East Tech Business Manager
Industry: Retail and Retail Luxury Goods and Jewelry
Description:
**About The Role**
Founded by Gabrielle Chanel in 1910, CHANEL is a French luxury house renowned for its timeless elegance and innovation across Fashion, Fragrance & Beauty, and Watches & Fine Jewelry.
  
  
The Europe Region brings together several markets to distribute CHANEL’s creations and deliver the ultimate luxury experience to our clients.
  
  
Headquartered in Dubai, the Middle East Market covers nine countries: United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait, Egypt and Jordan.
  
  
We are looking for a Middle East Tech Business Manager to support both the operational excellence and continued technology transformation of the Market.
  
  
Reporting to the Head of Digital and Tech, the Middle East Tech Business Manager acts as
**a Tech business partner for the Middle East Market, connecting local business priorities with the Europe Tech Roadmap.**
The role is responsible for ensuring the reliable, secure and effective delivery of IT infrastructure and technology services across the Market's business environments, including boutiques, wholesale operations, the distribution center and headquarters.
  
  
These services include end-user equipment, connectivity, servers, retail systems, meeting rooms, video-conferencing solutions and digital workplace technologies.
  
  
The Tech Business Manager leads a team of four people, one internal employee and three external resources. He/she is responsible for organizing, developing and evolving the team and its capabilities in line with changing business and technology needs, while managing the Tech budget, procurement activities, vendors and partners and ensuring a high level of service and delivery.
  
  
What impact you can create at CHANEL
  
  
Beyond operational excellence, the Tech Business Manager partners closely with Retail, business functions and Digital & Data teams to enable technology-driven transformation across the Market. The role contributes to Retail and business projects, identifies opportunities where technology can address business challenges, and supports the deployment and adoption of new technologies, including emerging AI capabilities.
  
  
As an ambassador for the Tech department, the Tech Business Manager ensures that the house technology strategies and standards are translated into relevant and effective solutions for the Middle East, while bringing local business needs and opportunities back into Europe Tech roadmaps.
  
  
**As an ambassador for the Tech department, act as a trusted Tech partner to the Middle East business, developing a strong understanding of business and Retail priorities, challenges and opportunities.**
Maintain close proximity to the business and Retail teams by regularly visiting boutiques and other sites, understanding user journeys and technology-related pain points, and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.
  
  
Monitor user satisfaction with Tech services provided, identify areas for improvement and recommend appropriate actions.
  
  
Translate local business needs into clear technology requirements and use cases,
**connecting the relevant local and Europe teams and contributing to the evolution of technology roadmaps.**
Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve Tech services, enhancing both operational efficiency and employee experience. Ensure appropriate business continuity and resilience of critical Market technology services.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Operational Excellence / Run
  
  
Enable local teams to work effectively by providing reliable devices, including tills, printers, laptops and mobile phones, infrastructure including network equipment and servers, and standard applications across boutiques, offices and other physical locations.
  
  
Ensure contractors and partners deliver high-quality Tech support and meet agreed Service Level Agreements.
  
  
Secure and continuously optimize Tech infrastructure and support operations across boutiques and wholesale businesses for all CHANEL divisions, Fashion, Fragrance & Beauty and Watches & Fine Jewelry, as well as Corporate functions including HR and Finance.
  
  
Accompany the Tech Transformation
  
  
Contribute and maintain the Middle East Tech roadmap and project portfolio, including budget, and demands prioritization with Europe Region and Middle East business teams.
  
  
Oversee the local implementation of Tech applications and services within the Market, ensuring local requirements are understood and addressed.
  
  
Partner with Retail and business teams on technology-enabled transformation initiatives, helping translate business needs into technology solutions and ensuring their technical feasibility, integration and successful implementation.
  
  
Contribute to the exploration and implementation of new technologies that can enhance client, employee and business experiences, working closely with Digital, Data and Europe Tech teams.
  
  
Contribute to real-estate projects, primarily boutique openings and renovations, as well as office and logistics projects. Oversee the implementation of technology components, including hardware and software installation and validation, and manage suppliers and subcontractors in close coordination with Regional and Global teams.
  
  
AI & Emerging Technologies
  
  
Act as the local Tech partner for AI and emerging technology adoption, working closely with Digital, Data, business teams and Europe Tech.
  
  
Contribute to AI acculturation across the Market by helping teams understand available capabilities, opportunities, boundaries and responsible usage.
  
  
Partner with Business & Digital teams to identify and assess relevant AI and technology use cases, supporting experimentation and a test-and-learn approach.
  
  
Support the technical assessment and implementation of prioritized use cases, ensuring appropriate integration, security, architecture and compliance.
  
  
**Connect local opportunities and learnings with Europe Tech teams.**
Cybersecurity & Compliance
  
  
Implement cybersecurity guidelines in coordination with Global and Regional Cybersecurity teams and support initiatives to strengthen cybersecurity awareness among end users.
  
  
Ensure Global data protection and technology compliance requirements are appropriately implemented within the Market, working with the relevant teams and addressing local requirements where applicable.
  
  
Promote responsible technology usage across the organization, particularly as new digital and AI capabilities are introduced.
  
  
Team Management & Capability Development
  
  
Develop and engage the team, creating clear responsibilities, effective ways of working and strong accountability for service and delivery.
  
  
Manage internal and external resources, ensuring the appropriate balance of capabilities, capacity and expertise.
  
  
Create a collaborative, service-oriented and forward-looking Tech culture, encouraging proximity to users, curiosity, continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
  
  
Budget & Partnerships Management
  
  
Contribute to annual Tech budget planning, oversee procurement and track actual expenditure, providing management with appropriate visibility over technology costs, investments and priorities.
  
  
Identify and establish relationships and contracts with local technology partners when required, in coordination with the Europe Tech team.
  
  
Ensure external partners meet agreed service, quality, security and contractual commitments.
  
  
Energizers
  
  
  

* Proven ability to build relationships with and manage key stakeholders.
* Good Understanding of the organization’s goals and objectives.
* Be able to understand business challenges and how IT can help to solve them.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across teams and build strong relationships within an international and matrix organization to drive business outcomes.
* Results-oriented, with a can-do mindset and strong problem-solving skills, adapting quickly to deliver effective solutions while ensuring alignment with IT standards.
* Client-oriented, ensuring users feel supported and valued while communicating technical topics in a clear and accessible way.
* Ability to work well under pressure and manage internal and external collaborators.

What you can bring
  
  
  

* Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in IT Management in a customer-facing role, with a proven track record of success.
* Excellent communication in English. The knowledge of another language of the Region is a plus.
* Strong knowledge of IT Service Management principles and IT operations.
* Strong experience of project management and ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and requests simultaneously.
* Knowledge of cloud-based technologies, networking, and database management.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Windows 11, M365 services and Linux operating systems and their management platforms.
* Knowledge of Service Now and Microsoft Intune is a plus.
* Certification in relevant IT fields is a plus.

What you will gain
  
  
  

* Team spirit and an inspiring company culture.
* Individual development opportunities and training.

At Chanel, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application (including references, notice period and your salary expectations) via our career website.

Title: Manager, Customer Value Management
Description:
We are looking for a CVM Manager to lead Samsung Gulf Electronics' Customer Value Management engagement with Telecom Operators across the GCC (UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman and Qatar). Based in Dubai, this regional role designs and runs data-driven base management and lifecycle programs that operators use to grow the value of their existing customers, positioning Samsung as a value partner that brings device, ecosystem and customer insight to those programs.

**How You Will Make An Impact:**

**Strategy & Operator Partnership**

* Act as Samsung's lead for CVM topics with operator CVM and base management teams across five markets, reporting to the Head of CRM & Analytics.
* Develop the GCC CVM strategy and annual joint operator plans, with agreed KPIs and governance in each market.
* Co-design base management and lifecycle programs covering segmentation, offers, channel mix and contact frequency, from acquisition and onboarding through retention, win-back and churn prevention.
* Lead quarterly business reviews, joint steering committees and commercial negotiations on scope, funding and timelines.

**Customer Insight & Analytics**

* Translate Samsung Customer Profile Insights into operator-ready use cases, such as device upgrade propensity, ecosystem affinity and next-best-offer recommendations.
* Apply AI and advanced analytics (propensity, churn and uplift models) with operator analytics teams, within agreed data-sharing rules.
* Structure test-and-learn programs with control groups, and report ROI monthly and in flight.

**Business Case & Growth**

* Build the commercial business case for each program, including Samsung investment, co-funding options and expected return.
* Drive Galaxy device upgrades and ecosystem adoption (Galaxy Watch, Buds, Tablets and services), TVs and loyalty, with measurable ROI in every market.
* Deliver a monthly CVM performance review with clear recommendations for senior leadership.

**Market Intelligence & Partnerships**

* Track telecom market dynamics (tariffs, competitor offers, 5G and fiber, eSIM, device financing and regulation) and adapt the CVM plan accordingly.
* Coordinate with Samsung Gulf product, sales, marketing, service, legal and privacy teams, and with HQ and RHQ CVM and data teams.
* Manage external partners (agencies, CVM platform vendors and data partners) to deliver on time and to budget.
* Build a regional GCC CVM playbook and share best practice across the Samsung CRM and analytics community.
* Keep all data sharing compliant with regional data-protection laws (UAE PDPL, Qatar PDPL, Bahrain PDPL) and operator privacy requirements.

**What You'll Need:**

* Minimum 7 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years in Customer Value Management, base management, retention, CRM or lifecycle marketing, with at least 3 of those years within a Telecom Operator or as a partner to one (OEM, agency or vendor).
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Data Analytics or a related field. A Master's degree or MBA is preferred.
* Hands-on experience leading CVM, base management or lifecycle programs at a Telecom Operator, including campaign design, execution and ROI measurement.
* Solid command of telecom base KPIs: ARPU, churn, net adds, CLV, usage, upgrade rates and tariff migration.
* Experience with CVM or campaign platforms and marketing automation (e.g., Teradata, Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Amdocs or Netcracker), with working knowledge of telecom BSS and billing systems.
* Working proficiency in SQL and analytics or dashboarding tools. Knowledge of HTML and tag management is an advantage.
* Experience with propensity, churn or uplift modelling, or working alongside data science teams to put models into operation.
* Track record of building business cases for senior commercial leaders and running joint programs with external partners.
* Strong understanding of GCC telecom markets and customer behavior, with knowledge of regional data-protection and consumer communication rules. Arabic is a strong advantage.
* Self-starter who sets own priorities and delivers results without close supervision, with strong influencing and collaboration skills.

**Why You'll Love Working with Us?**

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentive plan for all levels
* Flexible working hours schedule
* Visa, a Top-Tier medical insurance plan, and life insurance
* 22 days of paid annual leave plus public holidays
* An additional day off for your birthday!
* Yearly air ticket allowance & monthly parking allowance (if applicable)

Title: Strategic Account Manager
Description:
**About Orium**
---------------

Orium builds smart, modern commerce solutions for enterprise brands. We're the leading composable commerce consultancy and systems integrator in the Americas, with more composable launches than any firm in the region, and a member of the MACH Alliance. We combine AI, data and composable systems so people and intelligent agents can work together, and we partner with best-in-class technology providers including commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack across three lines of business: Commerce, DXP and Agentic.

We're a remote-first company with team members across the Americas. A certified BCorp for over a decade, we're based in Toronto, and in June 2024 we acquired the Mexico-based ecommerce agency Gluo.

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------

Orium is seeking a senior Strategic Account Manager to be the trusted partner for some of our most important enterprise clients. You'll own a small portfolio of complex accounts, be the person clients call when things get hard, and help them see their problems in a new way.

You're at your best in the room with senior stakeholders, whether you're leading a workshop, resetting expectations or making the case for what comes next. You'd rather go deep with a handful of clients than chase new logos, and you measure success by the trust you earn and the accounts you grow.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own 5 to 8 priority enterprise accounts as the main commercial contact and trusted advisor
* Act as the senior escalation point, leading honest conversations when expectations, scope or budgets need resetting, and getting relationships back on track
* Lead and participate in client workshops, steering committees, roadmap planning and quarterly business reviews, challenging assumptions and reframing problems when a client is heading the wrong way
* Drive account growth through renewals and expansion across our Commerce, DXP and Agentic practices, including partner-led opportunities with commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack
* Shape new opportunities with our delivery and strategy teams, from problem statement through pitch and SOW
* Help clients move from project work into ongoing optimization and managed services
* Develop and maintain account plans and forecasts in partnership with sales leadership
* Maintain strong working relationships with delivery teams to keep engagements on scope, high quality and aligned to client goals and KPIs
* Use AI tools for account research, meeting prep and opportunity spotting
* Travel to meet clients and partners across the Americas as needed

**Skills and Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* 5+ years in client-facing, revenue-accountable roles such as Account Director, Client Partner, Strategic Account Manager or Customer Success leader
* Experience at a professional services firm, agency, systems integrator or B2B SaaS company
* A track record of managing senior enterprise relationships through difficult moments, and coming out with more trust than before
* Experience working with B2B clients
* Confidence leading workshops and executive conversations, and the creativity to turn what a client asks for into a better problem to solve
* Proven ability to grow accounts through renewals and expansion, and comfort owning a revenue number
* Strong commercial judgment across scope, margin and forecast
* Knowledge of the digital commerce landscape, including composable commerce, modular DXP and emerging AI and agentic technologies, is an asset
* Experience with modern digital tools and an openness to integrating AI-powered solutions into your daily work\*
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-assisted decisions and workflows\*
* A mindset of continuous learning and the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and trends\*
* Based in Canada

* AI expectations will vary by role. Some positions focus on AI exploration and experimentation, while leadership roles may drive AI adoption and strategy.

**Is this Role a Fit for You?**
-------------------------------

The role emphasizes trusted client relationships, commercial acumen and creative problem solving. We value people with a maker's attitude, collaborative energy and entrepreneurial spirit. You'll find fulfillment in the role if you...

* **Are passionate about client relationships.** You can't sleep properly if we might miss a commitment, and you're the first to pick up the phone when something goes sideways.
* **Stay calm and direct in hard conversations.** You know that honest, well-timed conversations build more trust than avoiding them.
* **Love reframing the problem.** You get curious about the need behind the request and enjoy helping clients see a better path forward.
* **Have an interest in making the business work.** You're an entrepreneur at heart and see account growth as the result of delivering real value.
* **Prefer depth over volume.** You'd rather build long-term relationships with a few clients than chase new logos.
* **Thoroughly enjoy collaborative work.** You partner closely with delivery, strategy and sales, and you put the team's success first.
* **Are naturally curious about AI.** You look for ways to use AI and automation to work smarter, without losing the human touch.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Enjoy a flexible schedule of full-time hours. As a remote-first organization, we care about the work you do, but it's up to you to choose where and how you do it.
* Explore ongoing opportunities for professional development: training, conferences, certifications and in-house peer mentorship.
* Experiment with new techniques, wear multiple hats and learn about new disciplines.
* Pursue independent projects, explore new ideas and challenge yourself in your field with dedicated "Awesome Time" (self-directed professional development) annually and quarterly training budgets.
* On top of standard medical and dental coverage, we offer benefits like a parental leave top-up plan, an EAP, mental health coverage, virtual healthcare and a minimum vacation policy.
* Our Toronto HQ is a modern, ergonomic space with hotelling standing/sitting desks and an open-concept social atmosphere.
* Additional perks include in-house mindfulness sessions, remote group get-togethers and more!

The Canada base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $140,000 CAD, plus variable compensation of $30,000 - $40,000 CAD at target, for total On Target Earnings of $150,000 - $180,000 CAD. Orium lists this range in good faith, reflecting the expected compensation for this role in the specified locations as of this posting. The pay offered will depend on several relevant factors, such as education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, location and business needs. Please note, this range does not include any benefits that may be included as part of the total compensation package.

**Performance and Growth Expectations**
---------------------------------------

We emphasize accountability for outcomes, but autonomy in activities. Your work will be measured across a number of data points (peer, leader and project team feedback) and on the basis of client and user satisfaction. Your growth path is in your hands: you'll have ongoing meetings with your leader to help determine your path, but your progress will be based on what you hope to achieve and how you choose to access the resources available to you.

**Committed to an Inclusive Workplace**
---------------------------------------

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment as we build a workforce that reflects the diversity of the community in which we live, including those with disabilities. We are dedicated to providing accommodations in all parts of the hiring process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act and the Ontario Human Rights Code. If you require any accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs.

Orium uses AI tools for candidate communications, scheduling, interview notes and feedback summaries. Humans review all information and make every hiring decision.

**Committed to Social and Environmental Stewardship**
-----------------------------------------------------

Orium is committed to promoting and working towards a more socially and environmentally sustainable future. All employees are expected to make decisions and take actions in relation to their role and work that follow through on this commitment.

Title: Product Operations Manager II (Voice and Wifi)
Description:
GCI's Product Operations Manager II will be responsible for operational aspects of GCI’s product lines, enhancing customer experience and operational efficiency, and managing the product end of lifecycle (EOL). Build a foundation of excellence through metrics, business processes, best practices, budgeting, and reporting.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES AT ALL LEVELS:**

  

**Customer Experience and Operational Improvements**

* Evaluate and analyze consumer and partner interactions with products and services.
* Implement operational improvements for product lines based on analysis of service performance.
* Collect, analyze, and interpret user data, product usage metrics, and customer feedback to identify trends and opportunities for improvement on all products in the market within assigned domain.
* Work with product manager to recommend changes to product or end of life of product if performance is/is not being met.
* Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success and identify areas for optimization with product managers where relevant.
* Establish systems for collecting and managing customer feedback, including surveys, in-app feedback mechanisms, and qualitative feedback.
* For all operational improvement initiatives, devise a clear communication plan to keep the product team and key stakeholders informed.
* Responsible for product operations projects that help improve overall user experience.

  

**Manage Product End of Lifecycle (EOL)**

* Work with product domain leads to plan and execute the product lifecycle, including the strategic offering of the product lines, features, and devices in the market.
* Identify opportunities to retire products or features by managing day-to-day product performance, and implementing strategic fixes for the product, as needed.
* Work with product manager to define product performance and recommend new product fixes based on performance standards.
* Create an end-of-life (EOL) plan, defining key dates like end of sale, end of production, and end of support that minimize disruption and maximize customer satisfaction.
* Ensure all departments (product management, technology partners, sales, marketing, customer experience, and customer service, etc.) are aligned in the EOL plan.
* Develop a clear communication strategy for customers and internal teams, including the timeline and potential transition options.
* Create comprehensive toolkit materials in partnership with marketing to assist customer service during the transition period.

  

**Product Domain Support**

* Support a portfolio of product domains in their post-launch phase with a focus on improving the operational aspects of the products.
* Recommend a definitive conclusion and specific recommendations with clear actions.
* Clearly present data insights and recommendations to product teams to inform decision-making.

* Wireless
* Business Data & Voice

Description:

### **Job Details**

##### **Job Description**

**Job Description:**

*The* ***Functional Process Owner - Inventory & Warehouse Operations*** *is the business partner between Operations and IT for inventory and warehouse management capabilities in Oracle and connected systems. This role translates end-user needs and operational challenges into scalable process and system solutions, evaluates options with IT and system vendors, develops functional requirements and test plans, participates in testing sign-off, supports deployment and change management, and provides training and ongoing functional support.*

  

*The position serves as the functional bridge across Distribution Center Operations, including internal and third-party logistics operations, Manufacturing, Service, Supply Chain, Transportation, Finance, Quality, Master Data, and other impacted teams. The role is primarily focused on understanding how DC inventory processes execute and how those transactions integrate with Oracle and connected systems across the enterprise. The FPO works across business functions to streamline end-to-end inventory flows, improve system integration and data integrity, and reduce process gaps and inefficiencies without owning the DC's internal operating procedures. The FPO manages multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives and the day-to-day enhancement and support backlog with limited manager direction. Periodic travel to distribution centers, manufacturing locations, or project sites may be required, generally up to 15%.*

  

**You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:**

* Own the functional design and continuous improvement of inventory and warehouse management capabilities in Oracle and connected systems. Understand how internal DC and third-party logistics operations execute receiving, inventory movement, replenishment, shipping, returns, cycle counting, adjustments, and discrepancy resolution, and work across business functions to streamline end-to-end transaction flows, controls, handoffs, and system integration.
* Serve as the functional lead for Oracle inventory and warehouse management capabilities and their integration with WMS, transportation, automation, material-handling, labeling, parcel and carrier, quality, reporting, master-data, and other connected platforms used across the enterprise. Document end-to-end transactions and interface flows, monitoring, dependencies, failure points, recovery steps, and support ownership.
* Translate inventory and warehouse management needs into prioritized business requirements, functional designs, process maps, and acceptance criteria, with primary emphasis on DC and third-party logistics execution and its cross-functional impacts. Partner with IT and vendors on configuration and integration decisions, and lead root-cause analysis for complex process, master-data, transaction, interface, job, device, label, and reporting issues.
* Support testing and deployment for enhancements, integrations, quarterly releases, peak readiness, and new capabilities. Develop business test scenarios and acceptance criteria, coordinate business participation in testing events, manage business defects to closure, participate in testing sign-off and Go/No-Go decisions, and lead business cutover readiness, training, change management, hypercare, adoption, and transition to support.
* Own intake, triage, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment for the Inventory/Warehouse backlog, including incidents, defects, enhancements, process changes, and strategic initiatives.
* Lead complex cross-functional projects involving DC Operations, IT, Supply Chain, Transportation, Finance, Quality, Master Data, and technology partners. Manage scope, milestones, risks, decisions, resources, communications, governance, and measurable success criteria.
* Define operational KPIs and reporting requirements for inventory accuracy, cycle counts, receiving and shipping, order execution, transaction quality, interface health, and backlog performance. Use Oracle, WMS, Power BI, Databricks, and Excel data to identify trends, quantify root causes, build business cases, and validate benefits.
* Maintain process maps, SOPs, work instructions, configuration records, integration diagrams, test evidence, and support playbooks. Develop role-based training, coach SMEs and support teams, and establish reusable documentation, testing, deployment, and support standards.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex Inventory/Warehouse issues, coordinating business and IT resources, communicating operational impacts, and verifying root cause and corrective action. Identify recurring defects, manual workarounds, and control gaps, and lead improvements that increase throughput, inventory accuracy, service, labor productivity, and user experience.
  

  

**The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent directly related experience.
* 6-8 years of progressive experience in distribution, warehouse operations, inventory management, supply chain systems, functional process ownership, or a related operational/technology role.
* Hands-on experience with a Warehouse Management System in a Distribution Center environment, including inbound, inventory, replenishment, outbound, counting, and exception-management processes.
* Experience supporting WMS integrations with ERP and one or more connected platforms such as transportation management, warehouse automation/material-handling equipment, parcel or carrier systems, labeling, quality, or reporting solutions.
* Experience gathering requirements, creating process maps and functional designs, developing business test plans and acceptance criteria, participating in testing events and sign-off, managing business defects, and supporting deployment and adoption.
* Experience leading multiple cross-functional projects or major workstreams with limited direction, including responsibility for scope, timeline, risks, stakeholder alignment, and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to communicate technical and operational concepts clearly to DC users, IT teams, vendors, project teams, and leadership.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; working capability with process-mapping and work-management tools.
  

  

**Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:**

* Oracle Cloud SCM or Oracle E-Business Suite experience, particularly Inventory Management, Shipping, Receiving, Order Management, or related warehouse transactions.
* Experience with enterprise WMS platforms and integrations in a high-volume, multi-site distribution network.
* Experience with Power BI and Databricks, including reconciliation of dashboard or model outputs to source transactions.
* Experience with warehouse automation, RF/mobile devices, label-management platforms, EDI/API integrations, ASNs, transfer orders, carrier connectivity, or freight visibility.
* Lean, Six Sigma, APICS/ASCM CPIM or CSCP, PMP, Prosci, or comparable process-improvement, supply-chain, project-management, or change-management training/certification.

---------------

At NetApp, operational excellence is the foundation for delivering successful business transformation. We’re looking for an experienced Integration Manager to lead the planning, governance, and cross-functional coordination of Chief Administrative Office (CAO) activities associated with acquisitions, divestitures, and other strategic transactions. Sitting within the CAO Program Management Office, and working closely with Legal and HR leaders, Corporate Development, the enterprise Integration Management Office, and cross-functional partners, this role will bring structure, pace, and transparency to time-sensitive, cross-functional deal work. M&A will be the primary focus; as capacity allows, the role will also support other priority Legal and HR initiatives across the CAO portfolio.

***This is a hybrid role located in our San Jose, CA office (will consider those local to Research Triangle Park, NC as well). We currently require 3 days in office per week.***

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------

M&A requires disciplined and time-sensitive execution across multiple confidential workstreams, fixed milestones, and interdependent decisions. As Integration Manager, M&A Integration Program Management – CAO PMO, you'll translate transaction requirements and integration objectives into executable plans, establish governance and decision-making mechanisms, and drive alignment through critical transaction milestones including signing, close, Day 1, stabilization, and longer-term integration. Through program management discipline, you'll connect stakeholders, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure leaders have the information needed to make timely decisions, from early diligence and transaction planning through close and post-close integration, while attorneys and functional SMEs retain ownership of substantive legal and functional decisions.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**M&A Integration Planning & Execution**

* Lead CAO integration planning and program management for acquisitions, divestitures, and other strategic transactions across the full lifecycle, from diligence and pre-close planning through Day 1, stabilization, and post-close integration.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive integration plans with clear milestones, dependencies, decision points, risks, deliverables, and accountable owners.
* Translate transaction objectives, diligence findings, commitments, and functional requirements into actionable workstreams and implementation plans.
