Title: Locating Operations Manager
Description:
**Company / division** Danella Line Services, Inc.

**Location** Delaware, field-based (service area: Delaware and Maryland's Eastern Shore, Cecil and Harford counties)

**Employment type** Full-time, on-site/field

**Reports to** Regional Manager, Delaware

**About the Role**
==================

At Danella, we believe in developing and retaining the best people and providing the best value services to our customers. We take pride in everything we do to maintain the nation's infrastructure by connecting people and resources.

Danella is hiring a Locating Operations Manager for our Locating Division, based in Delaware. Our locators mark underground electric, gas, fiber and telecom facilities for utility and cooperative customers across Delaware and Maryland. This position runs day-to-day locating operations so that every 811 ticket is completed safely, on time and profitably.

The Locating Operations Manager works directly with the Regional Manager, a team of locate supervisors, the field workforce, and our accounting and payroll staff. You will be responsible to manage the daily numbers: tickets completed, production per locator, overtime, timesheets, idle time, ticket deadlines and billing data. This role suits a hands-on leader who is able to hold supervisors accountable and develop teams.

**Responsibilities**
====================

The Locating Operations Manager is responsible for meeting our customers' on-time, quality and safety requirements while controlling labor cost. Strong communication with supervisors, locators, accounting and leadership is essential.

* Lead daily locating operations for 80+ locators and a team of locate supervisors across Delaware and Maryland
* Run a daily operations meeting with supervisors to review the prior day's production, overtime, idle time and open tickets, and assign follow-up
* Set clear production expectations (tickets per locator per day and per hour) and coaching locators who fall short of safety or production
* Monitor ticket boards through the day, rebalance workloads, reassign tickets when locators call out, and route emergency tickets to the closest available locator
* Manage ticket due times and extensions to meet on-time requirements and avoid late-ticket and no-response penalties, including end-of-day board checks on a rotating evening and weekend schedule
* Make daily overtime decisions based on production data: approve overtime where it protects on-time performance, and limit it where it does not
* Review and approve locator timesheets daily, verify hours against vehicle telematics, correct discrepancies, and make sure timesheets are submitted on time
* Maintain the daily roster of who is working, off, called out, in training or on hourly assignments
* Track idle time, late starts and mileage by locator, and follow up on outliers with supervisors
* Prepare weekly and monthly billing data by customer, including ticket counts, billing codes, emergency and after-hours work, and over-footage extra charges, and reconcile ticket-system data with accounting before invoicing
* Know the terms of each customer contract (on-time targets, extra-charge rules, audit, damage and penalty terms) and bring pricing or commercial questions to company leadership
* Review customer KPI reports and penalty notices each month, check them against our own data, and prepare disputes where the data supports one
* Recruit, onboard and train locators and supervisors, including trainee rotations and refresher training
* Promote a safe work environment, including safe vehicle parking and idling practices, highway work zones and required safety sweeps
* All other duties as assigned

  

**Qualifications**
==================

What is required:

* 3+ years of experience in leading underground utility locating or damage prevention programs
* Working knowledge of 811 / One Call processes, ticket due times, extensions and marking standards; experience with Miss Utility tickets in Delaware or Maryland strongly preferred
* Experience managing to production and on-time KPIs on unit-price or production-based contracts
* Experience with a ticket management system
* Comfort working from live data: dashboards, timesheet systems and vehicle telematics with strong Microsoft Excel skills
* Willingness to learn new software, including AI-assisted reporting tools
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
* Ability to pass a background screening, physical and drug test
* Strong supervisory, leadership and team management skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including difficult conversations about performance
* Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail and accuracy
* Calm, steady and solutions-focused under pressure
* Highly responsible, accountable and dependable

**Availability**
================

* Full-time, field-based role with daily travel across Delaware and Maryland
* Participation in a rotating evening and weekend on-call schedule for end-of-day ticket board checks and urgent tickets

**Workplace Policy**
====================

Danella maintains a workplace that is completely free of drugs and alcohol, and employees are subject to random drug testing.

**What We Offer You**
=====================

* Paid on-the-job technical and professional training
* Defined career path for future growth
* Competitive wages and great benefits, including a 401(k) plan match

Title: Broker Relationship Manager
Description:
The Broker Relationship Manager will be responsible for developing, managing and strengthening relationships with insurance brokers, intermediaries and distribution partners to drive the promotion and sales of International Private Medical Insurance (IPMI) products offered by Dubai Insurance Company in association with Orange Care Plus.

The role requires a candidate with prior experience working with an insurance company, preferably within broker management, intermediary distribution or health insurance business development, with a strong understanding of the UAE insurance market.

The primary objective is to expand the broker network, generate business opportunities, drive product awareness and achieve IPMI business targets through effective broker engagement and relationship management.

**2. Primary Responsibilities**

1. **Broker Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with insurance brokers, intermediaries and distribution partners across the UAE.
* Identify, onboard and activate new brokers to promote DIC's IPMI products.
* Manage existing broker relationships to ensure consistent business engagement and revenue generation.
* Conduct regular broker visits, meetings and business reviews.

2. **Business Development & Sales**

* Drive the promotion and distribution of IPMI products through the broker network.
* Identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to expand market reach.
* Generate qualified leads, follow up on business opportunities and drive conversions.
* Achieve agreed business development, premium and revenue targets.

3. **Product Promotion & Market Development**

* Develop a strong understanding of DIC's IPMI product offerings, benefits, coverage and positioning.
* Conduct product presentations, broker training sessions and awareness meetings.
* Communicate product features, competitive advantages and market opportunities to brokers.
* Gather market intelligence and competitor insights to support product positioning.

4. **Business Coordination & Conversion**

* Coordinate with DIC's underwriting, operations and business teams to facilitate quotations, underwriting queries and policy issuance.
* Ensure timely follow-up on broker enquiries, quotations and pending proposals.
* Support brokers throughout the sales cycle, from initial enquiry to policy conversion.
* Monitor business pipelines and ensure opportunities are followed through to closure.

**3. Secondary Responsibilities**

* Prepare periodic broker performance reports, sales pipelines and business development updates.
* Monitor broker productivity, conversion ratios and business contribution.
* Identify opportunities to improve broker engagement, retention and business volumes.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve broker concerns and operational challenges.
* Ensure that all business activities adhere to applicable UAE insurance regulations and company compliance requirements.
* Participate in industry events, networking activities and insurance market engagements.
* Provide feedback to management on market trends, competitor activities and broker requirements.

**4. Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Insurance, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline.
* Professional insurance qualifications or certifications will be an added advantage.

**5. Experience & Competencies**

**Essential Experience:**

* 4–7 years of experience in the UAE insurance industry.
* Prior experience working with an insurance company, preferably in Broker Relationship Management, Intermediary Sales, Distribution or Business Development.
* Experience managing and developing relationships with insurance brokers and intermediaries.
* Exposure to medical insurance or IPMI products is highly preferred.
* Good understanding of the UAE insurance market and broker distribution channels.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong broker relationship management and networking skills.
* Business development and sales conversion capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong understanding of insurance products and distribution channels.
* Ability to independently develop business opportunities and achieve targets.
* Strong follow-up, coordination and stakeholder management skills.

Pay: AED7,000.00 - AED21,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Description:
WHO WE ARE

DRMG (Direct Response Media Group) is Canada's leading Direct Mail company, specializing in Targeted Direct Mail Campaigns that have helped businesses of all sizes boost sales and brand recognition for more than 20 years. As a Canada Post Expert Partner and their largest shared mail customer, we deliver a wide range of neighbourhood mail, including our widely recognized Money Saver brand, to over 175 million homes annually.

DRMG is a fun, family-focused, and entrepreneurial company where every person supports the overall success of the organization. Your work matters here, and we seek people who communicate well, build great relationships, and thrive in our complex and fast-paced environment.

Dollco Print Solutions Group has been a market leader in Magazine and Catalogue Printing for over 100 years. We continue to lead the print industry by providing creative solutions, exceptional customer experiences, and on-time service. We are proud of our committed, driven, and loyal team that focuses on building customer relationships and delivering excellent service.

OUR PURPOSE  
Helping Canadians save, businesses grow, and neighbourhoods thrive! Our purpose is to contribute to the success of our clients through continuous improvement and innovative solutions.

* We Treat People Right

* We Are Customer Driven
* We Are Always Respectful
* We Believe in Team Safety and Well Being
* We Strive for Excellence in Everything We Do

SUMMARY

We are hiring an IT Operations Manager to join our Information Technology team. This role will be a full-time, permanent position working out of either our head office in Oakville, Ontario, or our production facility in Ottawa, Ontario. Title: Sr. Manager, Professional Services - Pipeline Software Suite (Hybrid Work Model)
Description:
**Sr. Manager, Professional Services - Pipeline Software Suite**
**Location: Houston, TX or Dallas, TX**
**Model of Work: Hybrid**
Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation, and one that is reinventing itself as the AI platform for the energy industry.
  
  
Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.
  
  
**Overview**
Serve as a People Leader in the Global Services (GS) business unit, accountable for the successful delivery of Quorum Pipeline Transaction Management (QPTM) and the broader Pipeline Software Suite for midstream customers. QPTM is Quorum's enterprise-grade pipeline transaction management system, used by pipeline and storage operators to manage nominations, scheduling, capacity rights, imbalances, invoicing and settlement, and regulatory compliance. You will lead the team that implements, upgrades and optimizes it for some of the most recognized names in North American midstream.
  
  
**Why This Role, Why Now: Quorum’s Platform Transformation**
Quorum is in the middle of a major transformation. Our vision is to serve as the operating system for the global energy industry: a unified platform where every domain, from subsurface planning to supply chain execution, is connected through a common data foundation and a governed AI layer. We are investing heavily in bringing AI and analytics into the platform, and expanding through strategic acquisitions such as Streamba, an AI-native supply chain platform, announced in June 2026. As this platform evolution reaches our pipeline solutions, Global Services will be on the front line, helping customers move from systems that simply record transactions to a connected, data-driven platform that helps run their operations. This is a rare chance to shape how that transformation is delivered to our pipeline customers and to build the team and delivery model that makes it repeatable.
  
  
**Who Will Succeed In This Role**
The person who succeeds here will be both tech-savvy and deeply grounded in the oil & gas pipeline industry. You understand how a pipeline business actually runs, from nominations and scheduling to capacity release, imbalance management, contract and rate administration, invoicing, and FERC and NAESB requirements, and you can earn the respect of pipeline operators’ commercial, scheduling, accounting and IT leaders on day one. You are equally comfortable discussing cloud deployment, integration architecture, data quality and how AI and analytics can improve a pipeline workflow. You are a leader who can bridge the two worlds: translating what operators need into how the technology is configured, delivered and adopted.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead successful delivery of QPTM and Pipeline Software Suite implementations, upgrades, cloud migrations and legacy system replacements for natural gas and liquids pipeline and storage customers
* Bring deep pipeline industry knowledge to every engagement, guiding customers on scheduling, capacity, contract, imbalance, invoicing and regulatory (FERC/NAESB) processes and ensuring the solution reflects industry best practice
* Drive repeatability and consistency across pipeline implementations through standard delivery methodologies, accelerators and reusable assets
* Manage and lead a high performing team of 15+ employees, including consultants, project managers and technical resources
* Prepare the team and our customers for Quorum’s platform transformation, building fluency in AI, analytics, data and integration capabilities as they are introduced into the Pipeline Software Suite and the wider Quorum platform
* Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field insight into the roadmap, and help shape how new platform, AI and analytics capabilities are deployed with customers
* Oversee integration of QPTM with adjacent systems such as measurement (including Quorum FLOWCAL), accounting, ETRM and commercial applications to deliver an end-to-end customer solution
* Manage to quarterly customer satisfaction, revenue and project quality goals
* Manage customer satisfaction across implementation projects including managing relationships with customer leadership and acting as a trusted advisor at the executive level
* Coordinate to ensure all staffing needs are addressed, ensuring all resources are appropriately managed and utilized
* Create a positive and rewarding workplace for employees
* Monitor employee engagement and define plans to improve overall engagement and retention
* Support Sales activities, ensuring messaging for services is clearly defined and accurate
* Ensure a high degree of quality for any Services participation in Sales activities
* Effectively contribute to and communicate Company and Services organizational goals and ensure key performance indicator alignment across the business segment
* Drive effective cross-organizational collaboration including Sales, Support, Customer Success, Product and Engineering
* Contribute to a strong team culture in the professional services organization
* And other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in technology or business
* Deep knowledge of the oil & gas pipeline industry, ideally natural gas transportation and storage, including nominations, scheduling, capacity release, contracts and rates, imbalances, invoicing and settlements, and FERC/NAESB regulatory requirements
* Technology savvy, with a working understanding of cloud/SaaS deployment, system integration, APIs, data and reporting, and a genuine curiosity about how AI and analytics are changing enterprise software
* 8+ years in software implementations, preferably large enterprise solution implementations, ideally with pipeline or midstream transaction management systems
* 5+ years leadership experience managing teams of 10+
* Management of revenue, customer satisfaction and project quality goals
* Ability to utilize MS Office applications including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.
* Experience in customer facing roles at the executive level
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to effectively deliver presentations to all levels of the organization
* The ability to understand business goals and recommend approaches to effect continual improvements
* Strong organizational skills and an ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities/projects
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with peers in a team-oriented environment
* Effective project management and change management skills, including leading customers through major technology and process change
* Strong leadership skills, driving a positive and rewarding culture
* Strong interpersonal skills, capable of driving to solutions across organizations
* Ability to travel up to 25%

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Quorum Pipeline Transaction Management (QPTM) or comparable pipeline transaction management systems
* ETRM (Energy Trading and Risk Management) experience, such as deal capture, scheduling and logistics, risk, or settlements, and an understanding of how it connects to pipeline operations
* Experience with AI, analytics or data platform initiatives, including helping customers adopt and realize value from them
* Experience delivering cloud/SaaS and platform migration programs for energy customers
* Strong project management experience, preferably with agile methodologies

**Additional Details**

* Background Check: The successful candidate will need to successfully complete the following clearances: Criminal History Check, Education Verification, Employment Verification, Driver’s License Verification and passport/ID validation.
* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position. The successful candidate will be required to ensure they maintain and renew any visas or permits that grant employment eligibility where applicable.

**About Quorum Software**
Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration, and we are building the AI platform for the energy industry, with a common data foundation and governed AI layer that connects every workflow from the reservoir to the back office. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1,800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
Silvus Technologies, the global leader in advanced MIMO mesh networking solutions for defense, industrial, and public safety applications, is seeking a
**Senior Research and Development (R&D) Program Manager**
who will report to the Vice President of Research and Development (R&D).

**West Los Angeles,**
**CA,**
and is on a hybrid schedule, a minimum of 3 days onsite per week is expected. On-site days are Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.
  
  
The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

* Lead end-to-end program execution across the full engineering lifecycle, from concept and design through implementation, integration, validation, and productization.

* Facilitate cross-team collaboration to identify and resolve technical or schedule blockers, driving timely and data-driven decisions in collaboration with product, sales, and business development organizations.
* Track risks, dependencies, and issues; develop mitigation strategies and communicate impacts and resource demands to R&D leadership and upper management.
* Drive engineering cadence and communication, including design reviews, design syncs, and status updates with internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain project documentation and dashboards (e.g., Confluence, JIRA) for clear visibility into goals, progress, and key metrics.
* Prepare executive reports and presentations, communicating program status, milestones, and risk assessments to senior management.
* Hire, manage, and mentor various engineers, junior program managers, and other key personnel as needed to support the growth and success of the Silvus R&D organization.
* Perform other related duties, of which the above are representative.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field plus a minimum of 10 years of relevant program management and/or engineering experience in a technology-driven organization.
* Proven experience managing complex hardware/software wireless communications, networking, or electronic warfare programs in a fast-paced R&D or product development environment.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and shift priorities.
* Exceptional communication and presentation abilities with a track record of influencing across technical and non-technical teams.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen (due to clients under U.S. government contracts).
* All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Ph.D. in EE, ECE, or a related field with 15+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Demonstrated success with hands-on product development, technical program management, or engineering leadership roles.

Title: Project Manager - Program Management (St Louis)
Description:
**Description**

Burns & McDonnell is proud to be the market leader in providing program management services to the electric utility industry. As our clients focus on their capital investment in the energy delivery market, Burns & McDonnell brings a seasoned team to assist them across a variety of operational roles to ensure the needed grid improvements are executed on time and on budget. The ideal candidate will have a safety-first mindset, be dedicated to making their clients and teams successful, and take an entrepreneurial approach to their job. As programs are an extension of our clients day-to-day operations, roles within the program management track allow for frequent, often daily, client interaction. Engineers on the program management track leverage their technical expertise and education to make informed decisions in the execution of projects on behalf of our clients.

Project managers at Burns & McDonnell are a key part of our informal leadership structure. They will be expected to mentor junior staff and lead multi-disciplinary teams in the execution of our most complex projects. In the program management organization, project managers will be relied on to support the overall development of project management capabilities through the functional leadership of day-to-day task execution. Project managers may lead specific functional areas within a larger program or lead the entirety of a smaller program working directly with our clients to provide a premier client experience.

Generally, project managers in program management will pursue job responsibilities in the following areas:

**Project Management**

* Lead a cross-functional team to execute substation, transmission line, and telecommunication projects from inception through design and construction to closeout.
* Oversee 5-20 projects concurrently of varying sizes ($100k-$50M ) and voltages (4kV-765kV).
* Manage projects for schedule adherence identifying risks and requirements to successfully achieve a project’s in-service date.
* Navigate projects through client gate approval processes including presentations to senior and executive management as required by each client.
* Manage projects for financial adherence maintaining an accurate cost forecast reflecting committed and uncommitted costs for an estimate-at-completion.
* Coordinate craft labor resources with client approved vendors for construction, testing and other field activities.
* Provide regular status updates on projects by maintaining project data and routine reporting as well as meeting updates for clients.
* Lead project meetings with cost, schedule, real estate, environmental, construction and engineering resources to facilitate project execution.

**Portfolio Management**

* Develop a multi-year capital expenditure plan to support client’s replacement and betterment of electric transmission and distribution assets.
* Regular interface and coordination with project sponsor organizations to determine details of proposed plans and business justification.
* Ensure synergies across projects are incorporated into the portfolio of work to prevent scope from being duplicated or performed inefficiently.
* Monitor composition of client’s capital investment allocation to align with stated subsidiary investment targets for optimal rate of return.
* Engage with project sponsors to evaluate need-by date for realistic schedules and budgets.
* Assist with creation and compilation of rate filing support for federal and state filings.
* Review tabletop engineering estimates for accuracy and scope.
* Review project change requests (scope, In-service date, etc.) and reconcile with the existing and long-range portfolio of work.
* Interface with client’s accounting group to establish financial setup for projects.
* Create analyses & reports to assist the client in tracking, coordination, and execution of projects.
* Build baseline scopes, schedules, and budgets to be released to multiple client’s stakeholders.

**Outage/Construction Sequencing**

* Responsible for development of substation and transmission project construction lifecycles with focus on outage efficiency and constructability.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting specified deliverable dates and expectations.
* Analyze scoping and project documents to determine boundaries of required construction within substation and within electric grid.
* Conduct site walkdowns and project calls with project team as necessary to establish an achievable construction sequence with attainable outages.
* Analyze needed outages against adjacent outages scheduled in the area.
* Create initial outage sequence to communicate proposed construction lifecycle to project team.
* Coordinate with drafting resources to create engineering-caliber drawings that document the evolution of a project from present conditions to final state, and all needed incremental steps.
* As part of the Burns & McDonnell team we are looking for team members that foster a culture based on our MacCulture Principles, quality, diversity, and inclusion to enhance team cohesion and camaraderie. Individuals who want to tackle new and novel challenges within the utility industry to help our clients improve the execution of capital investment work can find entrepreneurial opportunities to assist in the pursuit and expansion of our program management offerings.

* Bachelor Degree in engineering, construction management or related degree from accredited program required.
* Minimum of seven years of experience in engineering design, project management or a relevant role required.
* Completion of P.E., PMP, MBA or comparable advanced degree strongly preferred.
* Excellent facilitation, collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to thoughtfully and positively influence, lead and manage.
* Strong planning and analytical skills.

* Must demonstrate superb oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to clearly and effectively present complex information to all levels of employees, management, and clients.

Title: Head of Information Technology
Description:
Welcome to
**MultiBank Group**
, a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. **Required Knowledge & Experience**

* Proven experience running IT across multiple countries or offices, ideally in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry.

* Strong hands-on experience with:

* Telephony platforms
* ITSM tools and frameworks (ITIL or equivalent) and Jira administration

Title: Engineering Manager
Description:
**Job Purpose:**

Lead team of software engineers within the Engineering & E-commerce function. Own the delivery, quality and production reliability of the systems within the assigned domain, such as ordering, menu serving, payments, loyalty, aggregator integration, in-store technology or customer platforms. Turn approved priorities into working, reliable software, delivered on time and at a controlled cost. This enables the company to serve customers and locations across markets and grow digital sales.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the assigned domain end to end - Own the architecture, roadmap execution, quality and production reliability of the domain’s systems and APIs. The scope of the domain will be assigned in writing by the line manager.
* Deliver the approved roadmap predictably - Define scope, estimate, sequence, manage risks and dependencies, and report status and trade-offs early, in line with the department’s software development lifecycle, so that commitments to the business are met.
* Own the system design and architecture of the domain - Propose designs and architecture changes and make technical trade-offs related to performance, resilience, data consistency, security, cost and time to market. Decisions must remain within the architecture principles and engineering standards established by the Director of Engineering & E-commerce and the engineering leadership.
* Own the reliability of the domain systems - Define and meet service-level objectives. Run on-call support, incident response and root-cause analysis. Monitor systems using the reliability tools provided by Platform Engineering and keep systems fast and efficient under peak loads.
* Use AI by default and advocate its use - Use AI for software development and the automation of other tasks, in line with the department’s AI usage standards. Maintain engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, secure coding and controlled releases, including feature flags, progressive rollouts and rollback plans.
* Act as custodian of the domain’s spend - Track cloud consumption, licences and contractor time. Identify and remove waste and raise cost risks early with the line manager. Commercial and budget decisions remain with the line manager and must follow company processes.
* Build, lead and grow a team of software engineers - Coach team members, provide regular feedback, manage performance and support career development. Contribute to hiring through the company’s recruitment process. Direct the day-to-day work of external developers, contractors or vendors when assigned to the domain.
* Align with peers and stakeholders before acting - Agree on interfaces, dependencies and priorities with other Engineering Managers, Product, Operations and business teams. Escalate disagreements to the line manager with clear options. Do not make unilateral decisions that change another team’s work, cost or risk.

**Leadership Requirements:**

* Ownership: Takes full accountability for the domain, its production systems and its people.
* Hands-on credibility: Designs systems and understands the code sufficiently to make sound technical decisions and coach engineers.
* AI-first mindset: Uses AI by default and leads the team to do the same.
* Delivery discipline: Plans realistically, commits carefully and keeps commitments.
* Calm under pressure: Leads clearly during incidents and peak periods.
* Decides through alignment: Works across team boundaries through agreement rather than authority.
* Financial responsibility: Treats company money responsibly in every technical decision.
* People development: Develops software engineers and builds a culture of engineering excellence.

**Major Challenges**

* Deliver new features while maintaining production stability.
* Manage dependencies on other teams and vendors that the role does not directly control.
* Reduce technical debt and modernize legacy systems while keeping the systems operational.
* Maintain delivery quality across a team comprising employees and external developers working in different locations.
* Migrate existing systems to the department’s standard programming language, Golang, while continuing ongoing delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
* Cloud or architecture certification is an advantage

**Experience:**

* Five or more years of software engineering experience, including at least two years managing engineering teams
* Proven experience designing and delivering production-grade, high-availability systems
* Experience with consumer digital platforms within quick-service restaurants, retail, e-commerce, marketplaces or logistics is preferred
* Experience working with external developers, contractor teams or vendor teams is an advantage

**Job-Specific Skills:**

* System design and architecture: Service architecture, API design, data modelling, distributed systems, modern system design and cloud principles
* Programming: Golang is preferred. Java, C#, Node.js or PHP are accepted. Willingness to learn Golang and migrate systems to Golang is required
* Databases and caches: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis or Aerospike
* Messaging and streaming: Kafka and RabbitMQ
* Monitoring and reliability: Logs, metrics, traces, service-level objectives, alerting and incident response
* Performance: Profiling, load testing, latency optimisation and cost optimisation
* AI for engineering: Daily use of AI tools for development and the automation of other tasks
* Engineering quality: Automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, and secure coding.

**Generic Skills:**

* Clear communication and the ability to translate engineering details into business impact
* Stakeholder management
* Project management, including planning, estimation, risk management and dependency management
* Coaching and performance management

**Competencies:**

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ownership and accountability
* Delivery focus
* Collaboration and influence
* Developing people
* Customer focus
* Integrity

**Technical Competencies**

* System Design and Architecture: Advanced
* Backend Engineering: Advanced
* Reliability, Monitoring and Performance: Advanced
* AI-Assisted Engineering: Advanced
* Data Stores and Messaging: Advanced
* Cloud Principles: Intermediate
* Security and Data Privacy: Intermediate

Title: Technical Account Manager - Openshift (Remote, Doha with French)
Description:
Red Hat's Technical Services team is looking for an experienced, enterprise-level engineer to join us as a OpenShift Technical Account Manager (TAM).

In this role, you'll work with a small set of key customers to provide hands-on technical and architectural guidance for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.

At Red Hat, customer support includes far more than just “break-fix” solutions. Customers get industry-leading resources that enable their technical environments to run efficiently, so they can focus on growing their businesses.

Technical account management is a premium support offering that builds, maintains, and grows long-lasting customer loyalty between Red Hat and our customers.

You will forge relationships with your customers, develop a deep technical understanding of their Red Hat implementation, share technical best practices and act as point of contact for any major incidents, managing the customer’s expectations and communications through resolution of such incidents.

You will tailor support for each customer's environment, facilitate collaboration with their other vendors and advocate on their behalf. At the same time, you'll work closely with our Engineering, Research and Development, Product Management, and Global Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues.

The ideal TAM is a team player, enjoys working hard, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, building relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, is able to learn new technologies quickly and uses their time efficiently.

**What you will do:**

  

* Develop relationships with key business and IT stakeholders and become an expert on a customer’s implementation by understanding their top business goals and priorities.
* Perform technical reviews and share knowledge to proactively identify and prevent issues
* Forewarn customers of technology changes or potential disruptions to their service and advice on mitigation strategies.
* Provide advice and guidance to customers about their current and future Red Hat products;
* Troubleshoot technical issues and drive issue escalation with Red Hat and customer teams
* Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer leadership
* Manage customer use cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans and keep the documentation on the customer's environment updated
* Manage and grow customer relationships by delivering attentive, relationship-based support
* Build a sense of trust with customers and serve as their advocate within Red Hat
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas
* Partner closely with Red Hat Engineering, Product Management, and Technical Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues
* Travel, as necessary, to visit customers and attend events within the region
* Learn new technologies quickly, including topics like container orchestration, container registries, container build strategies, and microservices on container platforms
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat cloud technologies strategy
* Engage with Red Hat’s product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns, based on customer engagements, as well as personal experience, that drive platform adoption
* Engage with Red Hat’s field teams, customers, and partners to ensure a positive cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success
* Communicate how specific Red Hat cloud solutions and our cloud roadmap align to customer use cases

**What you will bring:**

* Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
* Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with an eye for detail
* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
* Good verbal and written communication skills in French

Title: Business Development Manager - Saudi National

**Impact a better future**

At **Serco**, we bring together the right people, technology, and partners to deliver innovative solutions that impact a better future.

We have been operating in the Middle East since 1947 and have a profound understanding of the region.

With over 4,500 colleagues here, we support governments across defence, space, transport, emergency services, justice and migration, and other vital public services. Working under the direction of the Chief Growth Officer, the role drives pipeline development, builds and maintains client relationships and leads the sales effort on assigned opportunities and accounts, supporting Serco's positioning as a trusted, high-quality partner in delivering Vision 2030 priorities.

The role works side by side with the Business Development and Advisory teams, combining personal origination and account management with close collaboration on propositions, bids and the client engagement programme. It targets ministries, government entities, PIF-backed organisations, giga-projects and national energy, defence and space players, converting opportunities into sustainable revenue and operational growth.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Sales Delivery and Revenue Growth**

* Accountable for delivering assigned new business revenue and profit targets across the government, energy, defence and space sectors in the KSA, through personal origination, account growth and pipeline conversion.
* Execute the sector sales plan agreed with the Sales Director, covering government services, ministries, PIF and giga-projects, energy (oil and gas, power and utilities, renewables and energy transition), defence and space.
* Build and maintain a qualified, high-quality pipeline that meets short- and long-term growth ambitions, with accurate pipeline data maintained in MS Dynamics.
* Use market analysis and intelligence, shared with the Business Development and Advisory teams, to identify target clients, emerging trends, competitor activity and whitespace aligned to Vision 2030 priorities.
* Track and report on pipeline, forecast and conversion performance, escalating risks to targets to the Sales Director.

**Client Access and Relationship Development**

* Own relationships with assigned clients at senior level across ministries, government agencies, PIF entities, giga-projects and energy, defence and space organisations, escalating strategic and executive-level engagement to the Sales Director.
* Build and sustain a network of clients, partners and key stakeholders across the target sectors.
* Engage clients early in their decision-making cycle to understand requirements and position Serco's solutions.
* Implement the structured Client Engagement Programme and maintain account plans for assigned major customers, in line with the framework set by the Sales Director.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, working with the Advisory team to offer insight that leads to repeat business.

**Commercial Support and Negotiation**

* Lead commercial negotiations on assigned opportunities within delegated authority, escalating major or strategic negotiations to the Sales Director and General Manager – KSA.
* Contribute to the structuring of contracts, partnerships and joint ventures, working with Commercial and Finance colleagues to ensure commercial robustness.
* Maintain awareness of pricing, margin performance, risk allocation and contract terms to support profitable, sustainable growth.
* Balance client needs, delivery credibility and commercial outcomes when closing opportunities.

**Propositions and Joint Working**

* Work alongside the Business Development and Advisory teams to shape government, energy, defence and space propositions, bringing client insight and helping validate market need and competitor positioning.
* Contribute to joint propositions and commercial models, including local partnerships and strategic supplier relationships, that showcase end-to-end solutions.
* Support go-to-market activity, including customer segmentation, sales analytics and the packaging of propositions with marketing experts.
* Work with the Advisory team to create an advisory-to-operations pathway that unlocks downstream implementation and long-term contract opportunities.
* Share client feedback and market insight to strengthen Serco's existing unique selling propositions and inform new products and service offerings.

**Bid Support**

* Work closely with the Bidding team to ensure timely, high-quality submissions for all targeted opportunities.
* Lead the sales input to bids on assigned opportunities, ensuring a persuasive, commercially competitive offering that fully reflects customer requirements.
* Guide assigned bids through Serco's internal governance and approval process, with the support of the Bidding team and the Sales Director.
* Understand local laws, public procurement processes and government buying environments in the KSA.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Representation**

* Advocate for Serco externally and internally at a senior level, representing the Sales Director where required.
* Pitch Serco's capabilities and deliver value propositions against client requirements through high-quality presentations and proposals.
* Represent Serco at industry conferences, trade shows and networking events in KSA.
* Work with colleagues to share operational good practice, exploit synergies and promote cross-selling across sectors and business units.

**Team Contribution, Reporting and Compliance**

* Support and guide junior sales and business development colleagues, and contribute to the development of local talent in line with Saudization and capability-building objectives.
* Act as sales sponsor on assigned accounts, working with Operations to ensure quality, client satisfaction and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activity and provide regular updates to the Sales Director and senior management.

**Role Overview**  
The Manager, IT Audit reports to the Director, IT Audit and is responsible for planning and executing risk-based technology audit and advisory engagements. This role focuses on assessing risks and controls across cloud environments, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, and enterprise technology platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with technology and business stakeholders to provide practical, risk-based recommendations that strengthen governance, risk management, and control processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve audit efficiency, risk assessment, testing methodologies, and reporting processes.
* Assess governance and controls over AI and machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, monitoring, explainability, accountability, bias management, and data governance.
* Develop and execute data-enabled audit approaches using analytics, visualization, automation, and continuous auditing techniques.
* Assess risks associated with generative AI technologies, large language models, agentic systems, and third-party AI services.
* Lead and execute technology audit engagements from planning through reporting.
* Perform audits of cloud environments, including governance, security, identity and access management, resilience, and third-party risk controls.
* Assess DevSecOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, secure software development practices, and deployment controls.
* Evaluate governance, risk management, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations associated with AI solutions and emerging technologies.
* Assess IT general controls, automated controls, application controls, and cybersecurity controls.
* Participate in audits of major technology transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, and digital programs.
* Support integrated audits by identifying technology risks that may impact business processes.
* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging risks and industry trends related to cloud computing, AI, cyber security, and software engineering.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across audit methodologies, quality assurance processes, audit technology, and reporting practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on risk, governance, and control matters.
* Provide guidance and coaching to junior auditors and co-op students where applicable.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of technology risk management and control frameworks including NIST, COBIT, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Hands-on experience auditing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience reviewing DevSecOps environments, Agile delivery practices, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle controls.

* Experience using data analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Diligent/ ACL, Python, SQL, Databricks, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding AI governance, AI model risks, data quality, privacy, explainability, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience with scripting, automation, or audit technology solutions to improve assurance effectiveness.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including identity and access management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident response.

**Professional Experience**  

* 5-8 years of experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, data analytics, or related assurance functions, with demonstrated experience leading complex audit engagements.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth management, or other regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience working with cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and AI-related risks is required.

**Education and Certifications**

**Mandatory Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

**Preferred / Optional Certifications**  

* CPA (Certified Professional Accountant) or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor)

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification.
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager).  
  + CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional).
  + Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
  + ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent AI audit certification.

**Leadership and Competencies**  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

**Additional Information**  

* Hybrid work model (3 days in office per week).
* Occasional travel may be required.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $86,000 - $123,000 which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

**Benefits*****:***

* **COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION & RECOGNITION:** competitive base salary, performance-weighted bonus, education/career support, option to join Employee Share Purchase Plan with employer matching component.
* **EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & INSURANCE:** competitive health and dental coverage, flexible plan for you and your family and short-term & long-term disability plans.

* **INCLUSIVE CULTURE AND DIVERSITY:** living our core values: Be a Team, Be Accountable, Be Better, engaging with community through Business Resource Groups (BRG communities are volunteer employee-led groups formed around a common interest, identity, or background).

**Position Summary**  
The Director, Provider Network Strategy and Contracting leads Aetna’s provider network strategy and contracting agenda for a geographic area of Florida “Market(s)”. This leader owns the market’s network performance, from the design and negotiation of strategic agreements with major health systems, physician organizations, and ancillary providers through to the delivery of measurable gains in affordability, access, and quality. The Director shapes the long-term direction of the network, serves as Aetna’s senior executive voice to the provider community, and leads a team of contract negotiators and network professionals. The role is accountable for market-level financial results and for aligning provider strategy with Aetna’s growth, product, and clinical priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Strategy and Leadership*

* Set and execute the multi-year network strategy for a Market across commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid lines of business, balancing cost, access, quality, and competitive positioning
* Lead, develop, and coach a team of network negotiators and contracting professionals, establishing clear performance objectives, negotiation standards, and accountability for results
* Serve as an enterprise thought partner to senior leadership on market dynamics, provider consolidation, and emerging risks and opportunities

*Negotiation and Provider Partnerships*

* Lead high-stakes negotiations with hospital systems, large physician groups, and independent physician associations, including fee-for-service, value-based, and risk-based arrangements
* Establish and sustain executive-level relationships with provider C-suite leaders, system presidents, and physician group principals to foster long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships
* Direct escalated contract disputes, reimbursement issues, and strategic provider conflicts to resolution, protecting both member access and Aetna’s financial interests

*Financial and Market Performance*

* Own market-level medical cost and affordability targets, using cost and utilization analytics, market intelligence, and competitive benchmarking to guide negotiation strategy and deal structure

* Oversee pipeline management, negotiation sequencing, and reporting of savings and performance results to senior leadership

*Value-Based Care and Quality*

* Advance the market’s transition to value-based and total cost of care arrangements, driving provider adoption and measurable improvements in quality and member outcomes
* Hold provider partners accountable to contract performance, directing corrective action, renegotiation, or network changes where warranted

*Cross-Functional Alignment and Compliance*

* Collaborate with Medical Management, Legal, Compliance, Provider Operations, Sales, and Product to align contract strategy with enterprise priorities and member needs
* Ensure network adequacy, access, and regulatory compliance across Florida requirements, CMS standards, and Aetna and CVS Health policies
* Maintain rigorous governance over contract documentation, approvals, and reporting

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of progressive experience in health care provider contracting, payer-provider negotiation, managed care, or a related field, including 3+ years in a people leadership role
* Demonstrated success leading complex, high-value negotiations with hospital systems and large physician organizations
* Deep expertise in provider reimbursement methodologies (DRG, per diem, fee schedules, capitation) and value-based and risk-based models
* Strong financial acumen, with the ability to evaluate complex financial models and translate claims and utilization data into negotiation strategy
* Proven executive presence, with exceptional negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills
* Track record of managing multiple concurrent negotiations and competing priorities in a fast-moving environment
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel

* Master’s degree (MBA, MHA, or MPH)
* Established relationships with leadership at major Florida health systems and independent physician associations
* In-depth knowledge of the Florida health care landscape, including market competitors, provider consolidation trends, and regulatory environment

**Job Title:** Head of Digital Experiences

**Reporting Line:** CEO

  

Collectivus Holdings is seeking a strategic and execution-focused Head of Digital Experiences to lead the vision, strategy, performance, and the ongoing evolution of our external-facing digital platforms across our portfolio of businesses.

This leader will oversee the digital product strategy and roadmap for our Learning Management System (LMS), Sorted app, and other customer-, retailer-, and partner-facing digital experiences.

The role is responsible for ensuring our digital products deliver meaningful value to users, support business objectives, and create a connected, intuitive experience across the Collectivus ecosystem.

Working closely with business leaders, Technology, Product, Sales, and Operations, this individual will translate business needs into clear digital priorities, partner on scalable software delivery and support processes, and drive measurable results.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Digital Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and own the enterprise-wide strategy for external-facing digital products and experiences.
* Establish a cohesive digital vision across Collectivus businesses while addressing the unique needs of each brand and customer segment.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, retailer adoption, operational efficiency, and revenue through digital solutions.
* Build and manage a prioritized digital roadmap aligned with business objectives, available resources, and expected returns.
* Evaluate new digital opportunities, partnerships, and capabilities that support long-term business growth.

### **Digital Product Ownership**

Provide strategic direction and product leadership for key digital platforms, including:

* **Learning Management System (LMS):** Guide platform development, user experience, educational content delivery capabilities, community engagement, and adoption.
* **Sorted App:** Own the product vision, user experience, feature prioritization, and ongoing evolution of the platform.
* **Additional Digital Experiences:** Provide oversight and strategic alignment for other external-facing websites, applications, portals, and digital tools across the organization.
* Ensure each platform has a defined product strategy, roadmap, ownership structure, and measurable performance expectations.

### **Customer & Partner Experience**

* Champion a customer-first approach to digital product development.
* Ensure digital experiences are intuitive, reliable, accessible, and aligned with customer and partner needs.
* Use customer feedback, usage analytics, and market insights to inform product enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to create more connected experiences across platforms and business units.
* Partner with commercial teams to improve digital adoption, engagement, and customer retention.

### **Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product Engineering to translate product requirements into scalable, secure, reliable solutions, with clear accountability for product priorities, engineering execution, and business acceptance.
* Work with business leaders to understand priorities, evaluate requests, and establish clear product requirements.
* Lead product prioritization and make recommendations on resource allocation and investment.
* Establish clear product milestones, acceptance criteria, launch readiness expectations, and accountability for digital initiatives in partnership with delivery teams.
* Coordinate internal teams and external vendors to ensure successful product development and launches.
* Identify and resolve competing priorities, dependencies, and execution risks.
* Ensure new functionality is supported by appropriate launch, training, and adoption plans.
* Ensure each product has appropriate production-readiness criteria, monitoring, service expectations, documentation, and support arrangements before launch.
* Help establish a scalable keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) operating model for digital products, including service ownership, support processes, incident escalation, and ongoing enhancements.
* Define clear decision rights and handoffs among product, engineering, project delivery, and operations teams, including ownership of requirements, technical delivery, business acceptance, and production support.

### **Business Performance & Accountability**

* Establish KPIs for each digital platform, including revenue and monetization where applicable, user adoption, engagement, retention, customer satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Own digital product operating budgets and develop business cases for new digital investments, including anticipated benefits, costs, and ROI.
* Monitor product performance and use data to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.
* Provide regular updates to executive leadership on roadmap progress, performance, risks, and investment needs.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of existing platforms and recommend where to invest, improve, consolidate, or discontinue functionality.

### **Team & Vendor Leadership**

* Build and lead a high-performing digital product function as business needs evolve.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes across digital initiatives.
* Manage relationships with external development partners, technology vendors, and service providers.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes.

  

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Digital Product Management, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, digital strategy, or platform leadership.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple customer-facing digital products or platforms.
* Strong understanding of product development, user experience, platform integrations, and digital ecosystems.
* Experience with SaaS platforms, mobile applications, LMS platforms, or retailer-facing technology strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to develop digital roadmaps and translate business objectives into actionable product priorities.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, technical resources, and external development partners.
* Strong commercial acumen, including experience evaluating product investments, business cases, and ROI.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and customer insights to improve digital performance.
* Experience operating across multiple businesses, brands, or international markets preferred.

**Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------

* **Strategic Thinking:** Connects digital capabilities to broader business priorities and long-term growth opportunities.
* **Execution & Accountability:** Translates strategy into measurable outcomes, clear ownership, and consistent delivery.
* **Customer Focus:** Understands the needs of retailers, partners, and end users and uses those insights to guide decisions.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Evaluates digital investments based on business value, adoption, cost, and return.
* **Cross-Functional Influence:** Builds alignment across business and technical teams without relying solely on direct reporting authority.
* **Pragmatic Problem-Solving:** Balances innovation with business realities, prioritizing solutions that deliver meaningful results.

**Measures of Success**
-----------------------

Success in this role will be evaluated through:

* Delivery against an approved, prioritized digital product roadmap.
* Increased adoption and engagement across LMS, Sorted, and other digital platforms.
* Improved customer and partner experience, measured through feedback and product performance.
* Achievement of agreed commercial and operational KPIs for each platform.
* On-time delivery of key digital initiatives within approved budgets.
* Clear product ownership, prioritization, and accountability across the organization.
* Demonstrated business value and return on digital investments.

Title: Senior Manager, Technology Sourcing
Description:
Requisition ID: 279434
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Join Scotiabank at a pivotal time of transformation, where Procurement is driving strategic value and innovation. As the Bank accelerates its adoption of AI and digital capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of sourcing within a global organization.

  

**The Role**

  

Shape the future of Technology Sourcing at Scotiabank

  

Scotiabank's Procurement function is at a pivotal moment — driving strategic value, commercial discipline, and innovation as the Bank accelerates its digital and AI transformation. As Senior Manager, Technology Sourcing, you'll lead high-impact sourcing strategies across some of the Bank's most complex and fastest-evolving technology categories.

  

You'll partner with Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, and senior business leaders to unlock enterprise value across SaaS, cloud & hyperscalers, infrastructure, software, IT labour, networks, and emerging tech. This is a role for a commercially sharp procurement leader who thrives on solving complex problems, influencing spend decisions, and delivering measurable outcomes beyond savings.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

* Lead end-to-end sourcing for enterprise technology categories from opportunity assessment and market intelligence through negotiation, contracting, and benefits realization.
* Build category strategies across SaaS, cloud, software licensing, IT professional services, infrastructure, and telecom anchored in spend analysis, supplier capability, and market trends.
* Design and run competitive events (RFI/RFP/RFQ), including evaluation frameworks, shortlisting, negotiation strategy, and award recommendations.
* Negotiate commercially strong agreements balancing TCO, consumption vs. subscription models, service levels, flexibility, exit rights, and long-term business needs.
* Optimize the existing portfolio: identify renewal, consolidation, license rationalization, and vendor rationalization opportunities.
* Partner with Third-Party Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to ensure alignment with policy, regulatory expectations, and the Bank's risk appetite.
* Manage strategic supplier relationships — performance, escalations, executive engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Track and report pipeline, benefits, milestones, and commitments with discipline and transparency.
* Act as a trusted advisor to Technology stakeholders and an escalation point on commercial and supplier matters with enterprise impact.
* Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite, risk culture and risk policies & processes should be considered/adhered to in day-to-day activities and decisions.
* Create an environment in which his/her team pursues effective and efficient operations of his/her respective areas, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational risk, regulatory compliance risk, AML/ATF risk and conduct risk, including but not limited to responsibilities under the Operational Risk Management Framework, Regulatory Compliance Risk Management Framework, AML/ATF Global Handbook and the Guidelines for Business Conduct.
* Build a high-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviors; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related; CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent is preferred.
* 5–10+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or supplier management — with meaningful exposure to technology categories.
* Deep familiarity with SaaS pricing models, cloud consumption economics, software licensing (perpetual, subscription, token-based), IT labour rate cards, and MSA/SOW constructs.
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation capability, backed by data-driven recommendations.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders (VP/SVP) and lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity.
* Hands-on with spend analytics, supplier segmentation, TCO modelling, and benchmarking .
* Understanding of third-party risk and regulatory expectations in financial services (or another regulated environment) is an asset.
* Familiarity with e-sourcing, CLM, and supplier management platforms.

  

**What’s in it for you?**

  

* A rewarding career path with diverse opportunities for professional development
* An organization committed to making a difference in our communities – for you and our customers.
* A competitive rewards program includes annual bonus, flexible vacation, personal and sick days, and comprehensive benefits that start on your first day.
* Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employees to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
* Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences every individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.

  

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto
  
  
Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.
  
  
At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Title: Senior Delivery & Engagement Manager
Description:
We are looking for Senior Delivery & Engagement Manager in Tampa FL

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Delivery & Engagement Manager to serve as the cornerstone of our client relationships and the owner of delivery excellence. This role is critical to achieving our strategic vision, moving beyond staffing to become a trusted advisor who delivers high-value transformation programs. You will be the single point of accountability for the end-to-end delivery of services, ensuring client satisfaction, operational excellence, and profitability for a portfolio of key accounts. Your leadership will be instrumental in successfully delivering major modernization programs involving IBM i, IBM Z, cloud migration, and AI integration.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Client Engagement & Relationship Management:**

* Act as the primary trusted advisor and single point of contact for senior client stakeholders (IT Directors, VPs, CTOs), understanding their strategic business goals and ensuring our delivery aligns with their objectives.
* Build and maintain strong, strategic relationships at the operational and tactical level to ensure smooth day-to-day operations and manage escalations effectively.
* Present a unified front with the Client Partner (Sales), ensuring commercial promises are deliverable and deeply understanding the sales context to maintain client trust.

**2. End-to-End Delivery Leadership:**

* Own the seamless delivery of complex service engagements, which may include multiple workstreams such as:
* **IBM i / IBM Z Modernization**
* **Managed Services & Support:**

* Partner with the Client Partner to identify and qualify

  based on client needs discovered during delivery, feeding intelligence to fuel account growth.

  **contract renewals**
  by ensuring such exceptional service delivery that the client chooses to renew and expand.

* Serve as the key liaison, effectively communicating and aligning

  .
* Represent the client’s needs internally and advocate for the necessary resources and support to ensure their success.
* Foster a collaborative, high-performance environment across geographical and cultural boundaries.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **15+ years of experience**
  in Delivery Management, Engagement Management, or similar client-facing leadership role within an IT services or consulting organization.
* **Proven experience managing a portfolio of accounts**
  and the ability to handle multiple client assignments concurrently.
* **Demonstrable expertise**
  in delivering projects and services across some of the following technologies:
* **Legacy Systems:**
  Deep understanding of IBM i (AS400), IBM Z, RPG, COBOL, and associated modernization paths.
* **Modern Stack:**
  Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), application development (.NET, Java), and integration middleware (API, MuleSoft, Boomi).
* **Managed Services:**
  Strong background in ITIL-based service delivery and SLA management.
* **Strong financial acumen**
  with direct P&L management responsibility for multi-million-dollar engagements.
* **Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills**
  , with proven experience building trust with both technical and executive-level clients.
* **Experience leading and motivating globally distributed teams**
  (US, India, etc.) is essential.
* **Strategic mindset**
  with the ability to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.

**What We Offer**

* A pivotal leadership role in a company undergoing a significant and exciting strategic transformation.
* The opportunity to work with large, enterprise clients on complex, cutting-edge transformation programs.
* A competitive compensation package, including benefits and performance-based incentives.
* A remote-first work culture with a focus on outcomes.
* The chance to be a key player in achieving an ambitious growth vision

Title: Senior Program Delivery Manager
Description:
Applause is seeking an experienced delivery leader to oversee a complex portfolio of digital quality services for a strategic enterprise customer. This person will serve as the senior connection point between customer stakeholders and Applause’s delivery organization, ensuring that testing programs are well governed, properly resourced, measurable, and aligned with agreed business outcomes.
  
  
The
**Senior Program Delivery Manager**
will provide unified oversight across testing workstreams, lead a team of Localization Quality Account Managers (LQAMs), and partner with Testing Services, Account Management, Community Operations, Product, and other internal teams. The role is accountable for the quality, consistency, and business value of Applause-delivered services.
  
  
This position partners closely with the customer’s designated internal program owner. Customer-side decisions—including internal strategy, policy, prioritization, organizational alignment, and program ownership—remain with the customer. The Senior Program Delivery Manager ensures that Applause understands those decisions and translates them into an effective service-delivery strategy.

* Provide coordinated oversight across relevant Applause testing services, including localization-related quality initiatives.

* Anticipate delivery risks, dependencies, capacity constraints, and changes in customer demand; create and drive mitigation plans.
* Maintain clear boundaries between Applause-delivered services and customer-owned responsibilities, escalating scope ambiguity or conflicting expectations when necessary.
* Build a resilient operating model with documented processes, distributed ownership, and appropriate backup coverage.

* Lead and coordinate a team of LQAMs responsible for day-to-day delivery across assigned workstreams.
* Establish clear roles, work allocation, performance expectations, communication standards, and escalation responsibilities.
* Coach team members on delivery strategy, customer communication, risk management, and executive-level value articulation.
* Balance resources and capacity across workstreams while maintaining continuity during periods of change, leave, or shifting priorities.
* Promote shared accountability and consistent delivery practices across the broader account team.

**Governance, Reporting, and Business Insights**

* Ensure that program reporting is accurate, timely, consistent, and supported by reliable data.

* Provide a clear escalation point for delivery challenges, cross-functional dependencies, and stakeholder concerns.
